function canvasCase(variant) {
  const checks={}, canvas=new OffscreenCanvas(8+variant,6);
  const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
  const same=(a,b)=>a.length===b.length&&a.every((v,i)=>v===b[i]);
  const pixel=(x,y)=>Array.from(ctx.getImageData(x,y,1,1).data);
  const fail=(f,type,name)=>{try{f();return false}catch(e){return e instanceof type&&(!name||e.name===name)}};
  checks.owner=canvas instanceof OffscreenCanvas&&canvas instanceof EventTarget&&Object.prototype.toString.call(canvas)==='[object OffscreenCanvas]';
  checks.context=ctx instanceof OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D&&ctx.canvas===canvas&&canvas.getContext('2d')===ctx&&Object.prototype.toString.call(ctx)==='[object OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D]';
  checks.arities=ImageData.length===2&&OffscreenCanvas.length===2&&canvas.getContext.length===1&&ctx.fillRect.length===4&&ctx.clearRect.length===4&&ctx.getImageData.length===4&&ctx.createImageData.length===1;
  checks.size=canvas.width===8+variant&&canvas.height===6;
  checks.initial=same(pixel(0,0),[0,0,0,0]);
  checks.defaults=ctx.fillStyle==='#000000'&&ctx.globalAlpha===1&&ctx.globalCompositeOperation==='source-over';
  checks.settings=ctx.getContextAttributes().alpha===true&&ctx.getContextAttributes().colorSpace==='srgb'&&ctx.getContextAttributes().willReadFrequently===true;
  const attributes=ctx.getContextAttributes();attributes.alpha=false;
  checks.attributesSnapshot=ctx.getContextAttributes().alpha===true;
  ctx.fillStyle='red';ctx.fillRect(1,1,2,2);
  checks.red=same(pixel(1,1),[255,0,0,255])&&same(pixel(2,2),[255,0,0,255]);
  checks.untouched=same(pixel(0,0),[0,0,0,0])&&same(pixel(3,3),[0,0,0,0]);
  checks.style=ctx.fillStyle==='#ff0000';
  ctx.fillStyle='invalid-css';checks.invalidColor=ctx.fillStyle==='#ff0000';
  ctx.fillStyle={toString(){return 'blue'}};ctx.fillRect(3,3,-2,-2);
  checks.negativeRect=same(pixel(1,1),[0,0,255,255])&&same(pixel(2,2),[0,0,255,255]);
  ctx.fillStyle='#00ff00';ctx.fillRect(-2,-2,3,3);
  checks.clipped=same(pixel(0,0),[0,255,0,255])&&same(pixel(1,0),[0,0,0,0]);
  ctx.fillRect(1000,1000,1,1);checks.outside=same(pixel(0,0),[0,255,0,255]);
  ctx.globalAlpha=0.1;ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
  checks.clear=same(pixel(0,0),[0,0,0,0])&&same(pixel(1,1),[0,0,0,0]);
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,0,0,.5)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,1,1);
  checks.cssAlpha=same(pixel(0,0),[255,0,0,128]);
  checks.alphaStyle=ctx.fillStyle==='rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.5)';
  ctx.reset();ctx.fillStyle='red';ctx.globalAlpha=.5;ctx.fillRect(0,0,1,1);
  checks.globalAlpha=same(pixel(0,0),[255,0,0,128]);
  ctx.fillStyle='blue';ctx.fillRect(0,0,1,1);
  checks.sourceOver=same(pixel(0,0),[85,0,170,192]);
  ctx.globalAlpha=NaN;ctx.globalAlpha=-1;ctx.globalAlpha=2;
  checks.invalidAlpha=ctx.globalAlpha===.5;
  ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle='green';ctx.globalAlpha=.8;ctx.restore();
  checks.restore=ctx.fillStyle==='#0000ff'&&ctx.globalAlpha===.5;
  ctx.restore();checks.emptyRestore=ctx.fillStyle==='#0000ff';
  ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle='red';ctx.reset();ctx.restore();
  checks.reset=ctx.fillStyle==='#000000'&&ctx.globalAlpha===1&&same(pixel(0,0),[0,0,0,0]);
  ctx.fillStyle='red';ctx.fillRect(.5,.5,1,1);
  checks.fraction=same(pixel(0,0),[255,0,0,64])&&same(pixel(1,1),[255,0,0,64]);
  ctx.reset();ctx.fillStyle='red';ctx.fillRect(0,0,1,1);ctx.clearRect(0,0,.5,1);
  checks.fractionClear=same(pixel(0,0),[255,0,0,128]);
  ctx.reset();ctx.fillStyle='red';ctx.globalAlpha=.5;ctx.fillRect(0,0,1,1);
  const image=ctx.getImageData(0,0,2,2);
  checks.image=image instanceof ImageData&&Object.prototype.toString.call(image)==='[object ImageData]'&&image.width===2&&image.height===2&&image.colorSpace==='srgb'&&image.data instanceof Uint8ClampedArray&&image.data.length===16&&image.data===image.data;
  image.data[0]=0;checks.snapshot=same(pixel(0,0),[255,0,0,128]);
  const transparent=ctx.getImageData(-1,-1,2,2);
  checks.readOutside=same(Array.from(transparent.data.slice(0,12)),Array(12).fill(0))&&transparent.data[15]===128;
  checks.readNegative=ctx.getImageData(1,1,-1,-1).width===1&&ctx.getImageData(1,1,-1,-1).data[3]===128;
  const blank=ctx.createImageData(-2,-3);
  checks.create=blank.width===2&&blank.height===3&&blank.data.length===24&&blank.data.every(v=>v===0);
  const clone=ctx.createImageData(image);
  checks.createFrom=clone.width===2&&clone.height===2&&clone.data!==image.data&&clone.data.every(v=>v===0);
  const array=new Uint8ClampedArray([1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8]);
  const supplied=new ImageData(array,2);
  checks.dataConstructor=supplied.data===array&&supplied.height===1&&supplied.width===2;
  const fresh=new ImageData(2,3);
  checks.imageConversion=new ImageData(4294967298,1).width===2&&fail(()=>new ImageData(NaN,1),DOMException,'IndexSizeError');
  checks.sizeConstructor=fresh.width===2&&fresh.height===3&&fresh.data.length===24;
  ctx.fillStyle='#123456';ctx.globalAlpha=.4;canvas.width=canvas.width;
  checks.resize=canvas.getContext('2d')===ctx&&ctx.fillStyle==='#000000'&&ctx.globalAlpha===1&&same(pixel(0,0),[0,0,0,0]);
  canvas.height='4.9';checks.dimensionCoercion=canvas.height===4;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgb(20, 40, 60)';ctx.fillRect('0','0','1','1');
  checks.rgb=same(pixel(0,0),[20,40,60,255]);
  ctx.fillRect(NaN,0,1,1);ctx.clearRect(Infinity,0,1,1);
  checks.nonfinite=same(pixel(0,0),[20,40,60,255]);
  checks.zeroRead=fail(()=>ctx.getImageData(0,0,0,1),DOMException,'IndexSizeError');
  checks.readRange=fail(()=>ctx.getImageData(Infinity,0,1,1),TypeError)&&fail(()=>ctx.getImageData(2147483648,0,1,1),TypeError);
  checks.required=fail(()=>new OffscreenCanvas(1),TypeError)&&fail(()=>canvas.getContext(),TypeError)&&fail(()=>ctx.fillRect(0,0,1),TypeError)&&fail(()=>ctx.getImageData(0,0,1),TypeError)&&fail(()=>ctx.createImageData(),TypeError);
  checks.numeric=fail(()=>new OffscreenCanvas(1n,1),TypeError)&&fail(()=>ctx.fillRect(1n,0,1,1),TypeError)&&fail(()=>ctx.globalAlpha=1n,TypeError)&&fail(()=>ctx.fillRect({valueOf(){return 1n}},0,1,1),TypeError);
  checks.receiver=fail(()=>OffscreenCanvas.prototype.getContext.call({},'2d'),TypeError)&&fail(()=>OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.fillRect.call({},0,0,1,1),TypeError)&&fail(()=>Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(ImageData.prototype,'data').get.call({}),TypeError);
  checks.illegalConstructor=fail(()=>new OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D(),TypeError);
  checks.contextEnum=fail(()=>canvas.getContext('bad'),TypeError)&&canvas.getContext('webgl')===null;
  checks.invalidSize=fail(()=>new OffscreenCanvas(-1,1),TypeError)&&fail(()=>new OffscreenCanvas(Infinity,1),TypeError)&&fail(()=>canvas.width=-1,TypeError)&&canvas.width===8+variant;
  checks.invalidImage=fail(()=>new ImageData(0,1),DOMException,'IndexSizeError')&&fail(()=>new ImageData(new Uint8Array(4),1),DOMException,'IndexSizeError')&&fail(()=>new ImageData(new Uint8ClampedArray(5),1),DOMException,'InvalidStateError');
  checks.readonly=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(ImageData.prototype,'data').set===undefined&&Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype,'canvas').set===undefined;
  const opaque=new OffscreenCanvas(2,2), opaqueCtx=opaque.getContext('2d',{alpha:false});
  checks.opaque=same(Array.from(opaqueCtx.getImageData(0,0,1,1).data),[0,0,0,255]);
  opaqueCtx.fillStyle='rgba(255,0,0,.5)';opaqueCtx.fillRect(0,0,1,1);
  checks.opaqueBlend=same(Array.from(opaqueCtx.getImageData(0,0,1,1).data),[128,0,0,255]);
  opaqueCtx.clearRect(0,0,1,1);checks.opaqueClear=same(Array.from(opaqueCtx.getImageData(0,0,1,1).data),[0,0,0,255]);
  const empty=new OffscreenCanvas(0,0), emptyCtx=empty.getContext('2d');
  emptyCtx.fillRect(0,0,1,1);checks.empty=same(Array.from(emptyCtx.getImageData(0,0,1,1).data),[0,0,0,0]);
  checks.isolation=same(Array.from(opaqueCtx.getImageData(0,0,1,1).data),[0,0,0,255])&&same(pixel(0,0),[20,40,60,255]);
  const originalArray=Uint8Array, originalPixels=Uint8ClampedArray;
  const iterator=Uint8Array.prototype[Symbol.iterator], arraySet=Uint8Array.prototype.set, pixelSet=Uint8ClampedArray.prototype.set;
  const trap=()=>{throw new Error('page buffer hook')};
  try {
    Uint8Array.prototype[Symbol.iterator]=trap;Uint8Array.prototype.set=trap;Uint8ClampedArray.prototype.set=trap;
    globalThis.Uint8Array=trap;globalThis.Uint8ClampedArray=trap;
    const safe=ctx.getImageData(0,0,1,1);
    checks.privateBytes=safe.data instanceof originalPixels&&safe.data[0]===20&&safe.data[3]===255;
  }finally{
    globalThis.Uint8Array=originalArray;globalThis.Uint8ClampedArray=originalPixels;
    Uint8Array.prototype[Symbol.iterator]=iterator;Uint8Array.prototype.set=arraySet;Uint8ClampedArray.prototype.set=pixelSet;
  }
  return checks;
}

function canvasUploadCase(variant) {
  const checks={},canvas=new OffscreenCanvas(8+variant,6),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
  const same=(a,b)=>a.length===b.length&&a.every((v,i)=>v===b[i]);
  const pixel=(x,y)=>Array.from(ctx.getImageData(x,y,1,1).data);
  const fail=(f,type,name)=>{try{f();return false}catch(e){return e instanceof type&&(!name||e.name===name)}};
  const image=new ImageData(new Uint8ClampedArray([
    255,0,0,255, 0,255,0,255, 0,0,255,255,
    255,255,0,255, 255,0,255,255, 0,255,255,255,
  ]),3,2);
  checks.arity=ctx.putImageData.length===3;
  checks.result=ctx.putImageData(image,1,1)===undefined;
  checks.rows=same(pixel(1,1),[255,0,0,255])&&same(pixel(3,1),[0,0,255,255])&&same(pixel(1,2),[255,255,0,255])&&same(pixel(3,2),[0,255,255,255]);
  checks.outside=same(pixel(0,0),[0,0,0,0])&&same(pixel(4,2),[0,0,0,0]);
  ctx.globalAlpha=0;ctx.fillStyle='blue';ctx.putImageData(image,0,0);
  checks.ignoresAlpha=same(pixel(0,0),[255,0,0,255])&&ctx.globalAlpha===0&&ctx.fillStyle==='#0000ff';
  image.data[0]=0;image.data[2]=255;ctx.putImageData(image,0,0);
  checks.liveInput=same(pixel(0,0),[0,0,255,255]);
  image.data[0]=255;image.data[2]=0;
  checks.inputSnapshot=same(pixel(0,0),[0,0,255,255]);
  ctx.reset();ctx.putImageData(image,1,1,1,0,1,2);
  checks.dirty=same(pixel(2,1),[0,255,0,255])&&same(pixel(2,2),[255,0,255,255])&&same(pixel(1,1),[0,0,0,0])&&same(pixel(3,2),[0,0,0,0]);
  ctx.reset();ctx.putImageData(image,0,0,2,2,-2,-2);
  checks.negativeDirty=same(pixel(0,0),[255,0,0,255])&&same(pixel(1,1),[255,0,255,255])&&same(pixel(2,0),[0,0,0,0]);
  ctx.reset();ctx.putImageData(image,0,0,-1,-1,3,3);
  checks.clippedDirty=same(pixel(0,0),[255,0,0,255])&&same(pixel(1,1),[255,0,255,255])&&same(pixel(2,0),[0,0,0,0]);
  ctx.reset();ctx.putImageData(image,-1,-1);
  checks.clippedDestination=same(pixel(0,0),[255,0,255,255])&&same(pixel(1,0),[0,255,255,255])&&same(pixel(2,0),[0,0,0,0]);
  ctx.reset();ctx.putImageData(image,0,0,0,0,0,2);ctx.putImageData(image,0,0,3,0,10,2);
  checks.emptyDirty=same(pixel(0,0),[0,0,0,0]);
  ctx.putImageData(image,2147483647,2147483647);ctx.putImageData(image,-2147483648,-2147483648);
  checks.extremeDestination=same(pixel(0,0),[0,0,0,0]);
  ctx.putImageData(image,0,0,2147483647,0,-2147483648,2);
  checks.extremeDirty=same(pixel(0,0),[255,0,0,255])&&same(pixel(2,1),[0,255,255,255]);
  ctx.reset();ctx.putImageData(image,'1.9','1.9');
  checks.numeric=same(pixel(1,1),[255,0,0,255]);
  ctx.reset();
  checks.shortOverload=fail(()=>ctx.putImageData(image,0,0,99),TypeError)&&fail(()=>ctx.putImageData(image,0,0,99,99,0),TypeError)&&same(pixel(0,0),[0,0,0,0]);
  checks.required=fail(()=>ctx.putImageData(image,0),TypeError);
  checks.brand=fail(()=>ctx.putImageData({data:image.data,width:3,height:2},0,0),TypeError)&&fail(()=>ctx.putImageData(null,0,0),TypeError);
  checks.receiver=fail(()=>OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.putImageData.call({},image,0,0),TypeError);
  checks.range=fail(()=>ctx.putImageData(image,Infinity,0),TypeError)&&fail(()=>ctx.putImageData(image,2147483648,0),TypeError)&&fail(()=>ctx.putImageData(image,0,0,0,0,NaN,1),TypeError);
  checks.bigint=fail(()=>ctx.putImageData(image,1n,0),TypeError)&&fail(()=>ctx.putImageData(image,0,0,0,0,1n,1),TypeError);
  const alpha=new ImageData(new Uint8ClampedArray([255,0,0,128, 255,255,255,0]),2,1);
  ctx.reset();ctx.fillStyle='blue';ctx.fillRect(0,0,2,1);ctx.putImageData(alpha,0,0);
  checks.replaces=same(pixel(0,0),[255,0,0,128]);
  checks.transparent=same(pixel(1,0),[0,0,0,0]);
  const opaque=new OffscreenCanvas(2,1).getContext('2d',{alpha:false,willReadFrequently:true});
  opaque.putImageData(alpha,0,0);
  checks.opaque=same(Array.from(opaque.getImageData(0,0,1,1).data),[128,0,0,255])&&same(Array.from(opaque.getImageData(1,0,1,1).data),[0,0,0,255]);
  ctx.reset();const selected=ctx.createImageData(1,1);selected.data.set([0,255,0,255]);
  const oldArray=Uint8Array,oldPixels=Uint8ClampedArray,arraySet=Uint8Array.prototype.set,pixelSet=Uint8ClampedArray.prototype.set,iterator=Uint8ClampedArray.prototype[Symbol.iterator];
  const trap=()=>{throw new Error('page upload hook')};
  try{
    Uint8Array.prototype.set=trap;Uint8ClampedArray.prototype.set=trap;Uint8ClampedArray.prototype[Symbol.iterator]=trap;globalThis.Uint8Array=trap;globalThis.Uint8ClampedArray=trap;
    ctx.putImageData(selected,0,0);const actual=ctx.getImageData(0,0,1,1).data;
    checks.privateInput=actual[1]===255&&actual[3]===255;
  }finally{
    globalThis.Uint8Array=oldArray;globalThis.Uint8ClampedArray=oldPixels;Uint8Array.prototype.set=arraySet;Uint8ClampedArray.prototype.set=pixelSet;Uint8ClampedArray.prototype[Symbol.iterator]=iterator;
  }
  const detached=ctx.createImageData(1,1);detached.data.buffer.transfer();
  checks.detached=fail(()=>ctx.putImageData(detached,0,0),DOMException,'InvalidStateError');
  checks.detachedEmpty=fail(()=>ctx.putImageData(detached,0,0,0,0,0,0),DOMException,'InvalidStateError');
  checks.detachedConversion=fail(()=>ctx.putImageData(detached,Infinity,0),TypeError)&&fail(()=>new ImageData(detached.data,1),DOMException,'InvalidStateError');
  const backing=new Uint8ClampedArray([1,2,3,4,0,0,255,255,5,6,7,8]);
  const sub=new ImageData(new Uint8ClampedArray(backing.buffer,4,4),1,1);ctx.putImageData(sub,0,0);
  checks.byteOffset=same(pixel(0,0),[0,0,255,255]);
  checks.resizable=fail(()=>new ImageData(new Uint8ClampedArray(new ArrayBuffer(4,{maxByteLength:8})),1),TypeError);
  return checks;
}

function canvasCompositingCase(variant) {
  const canvas=new OffscreenCanvas(8+variant,2),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
  const checks={},exact={},pixels={};
  const pixel=(x,y)=>Array.from(ctx.getImageData(x,y,1,1).data);
  const equal=(a,b)=>a.length===b.length&&a.every((v,i)=>v===b[i]);
  const close=(a,b)=>a.length===b.length&&Math.abs(a[3]-b[3])<=1&&a.slice(0,3).every((v,i)=>Math.abs(Math.round(v*a[3]/255)-Math.round(b[i]*b[3]/255))<=1);
  const image=new ImageData(new Uint8ClampedArray([0,255,0,255]),1,1);
  const unbounded=['copy','source-in','source-out','destination-in','destination-atop'];
  for(const [mode,samples] of Object.entries(canvasCompositingReference.samples)) {
    ctx.reset();ctx.globalCompositeOperation=mode;ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';ctx.restore();
    checks['state:'+mode]=ctx.globalCompositeOperation===mode;
    for(const [kind,expected] of Object.entries(samples)) {
      ctx.reset();ctx.fillStyle=kind==='opaque'?'blue':kind==='dark'?'#102030':kind==='gray'?'#808080':'#4080c0';
      ctx.globalAlpha=kind==='backdropAlpha'?.5:1;ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation=mode;ctx.fillStyle=kind==='opaque'?'red':kind==='dark'?'#f0e0d0':kind==='gray'?'#c0c0c0':'#c06020';
      ctx.globalAlpha=kind==='alpha'||kind==='backdropAlpha'?.5:kind==='gray'?.25:1;ctx.fillRect(1,0,1,1);
      const actual=pixel(1,0),key=mode+':'+kind;
      checks['pixels:'+key]=close(actual,expected);exact[key]=equal(actual,expected);pixels[key]=actual;
      if(kind==='opaque')checks['bounds:'+mode]=equal(pixel(0,0),unbounded.includes(mode)?[0,0,0,0]:[0,0,255,255])&&equal(pixel(canvas.width-1,1),unbounded.includes(mode)?[0,0,0,0]:[0,0,255,255]);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha=0;ctx.putImageData(image,0,0);
    const uploaded=pixel(0,0);ctx.clearRect(0,0,1,1);
    checks['direct:'+mode]=equal(uploaded,[0,255,0,255])&&equal(pixel(0,0),[0,0,0,0])&&ctx.globalCompositeOperation===mode;
  }
  ctx.reset();ctx.globalCompositeOperation='copy';ctx.fillStyle='blue';ctx.putImageData(image,0,0);ctx.fillRect(1000,1000,1,1);
  checks.outsideCopy=equal(pixel(0,0),[0,0,0,0]);
  ctx.putImageData(image,0,0);ctx.fillRect(0,0,0,1);checks.zeroCopy=equal(pixel(0,0),[0,0,0,0]);
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation={toString(){return 'multiply'}};ctx.globalCompositeOperation='normal';ctx.globalCompositeOperation='invalid';
  checks.invalidMode=ctx.globalCompositeOperation==='source-over';
  ctx.save();ctx.reset();ctx.restore();checks.resetMode=ctx.globalCompositeOperation==='source-over';
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation='copy';ctx.putImageData(image,0,0);ctx.globalAlpha=0;ctx.fillRect(0,0,1,1);checks.transparentCopy=equal(pixel(0,0),[0,0,0,0]);
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.globalCompositeOperation='multiply';canvas.width=canvas.width;checks.resizeMode=ctx.globalCompositeOperation==='source-over';
  return {checks,exact,pixels};
}
